query: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_links_unresolved (source_id, target_id) SELECT json_extract(je.value, '$[0]'), json_extract(je.value, '$[1]') FROM json_each(?1) je WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block_links bl WHERE bl.source_id = json_extract(je.value, '$[0]') AND bl.target_id = json_extract(je.value, '$[1]'))
